label: Notion
description: Search, read, append to and create pages in the connected Notion workspace.

auth.guide:
Notion connects with an internal integration token you mint yourself and paste once.

1. Open https://www.notion.so/my-integrations and create a new internal integration in your workspace.
2. Capabilities: read content, update content, insert content.
3. Copy the internal integration secret and paste it here. It is sealed on this machine and never shown again.
4. In Notion, open each page Athena may touch and add the integration under Connections. An integration sees nothing it has not been shared.

Writing stays off until you turn writes on and list the page ids Athena may write to.

To revoke: delete the integration at https://www.notion.so/my-integrations. Disconnect here destroys the sealed value.
